name: Germany (GGL) Market Profile - Virtuelle Automatenspiele

bindingStandards.name: GlueStV 2021 section 6h - parallel play, elapsed time, waiting period

minGameCycleMs.notes: AVERAGE, not a per-round floor. Measured from the player's start declaration to display of the result. An average-based rule requires rolling-average monitoring in the game layer, which is a different implementation from a hard floor.

maxStakePerSpin.source: GlueStV section 22a(7) sentence 1 for the EUR 1 base (HIGH); sentence 2 empowers the authority to adjust (HIGH). The tiering and its date are MEDIUM.
maxStakePerSpin.notes: CRITICAL ENGINEERING IMPLICATION: the EUR 5 tier depends on no problem-gambling indicators in the preceding 90 days. Max stake therefore becomes a runtime service dependency, not a static config value. A real-time risk-scoring service must be queryable from the game session layer. Obtain the GGL Allgemeinverfuegung or licence-condition amendment, including the exact definition of the 90-day test, before building to this.

maxWinPerRound.value: No cap, but a win must be a multiple of the stake fixed before the game starts

autoplay.notes: A game may start only on the player's declaration, given only after the previous game ended. Program sequences that autonomously start a further game, and player declarations to take part in several consecutive games, are both expressly impermissible.

turboSlamStop.notes: No explicit ban located, but largely foreclosed by the 5s average floor and the per-game declaration rule (both HIGH).

featureBuy.notes: Constrained by section 22a(8) sentence 1 (win must be a pre-fixed multiple of the stake) and the stake cap. Flag for legal review.

jackpots.notes: Stakes and wins may not be accumulated to create wins for future games. Combined with sentence 1, this excludes all accumulated and non-fixed-multiple prize structures. THIS CANNOT BE HANDLED AS A CONFIG FLAG: removing a jackpot changes RTP allocation, so the German build needs a separately verified maths model with the jackpot contribution redistributed into the base game.

multiGame.source: GlueStV section 22a(10) within one operator; section 6h(1)-(4) across operators
multiGame.notes: Only one game may be displayed at a time. Cross-operator parallel play is blocked via the central LUGAS activation file, with a 5-minute waiting period before switching operators and auto-deactivation after 30 minutes of inactivity. A game supplier cannot satisfy this alone; it requires operator-side LUGAS integration.

otherProhibitions.item: Live table game look-alikes (roulette, blackjack, baccarat)
Non-euro currency, points or unit conversion before, during or after play
The words Casino or Casinospiele in slot operation, self-distribution or advertising
Land-based distribution of virtual slots (internet only)

disclosure.value: Must display the average payout ratio per EUR 1 stake AND the probability of winning the maximum prize, at the point where the stake is placed
disclosure.notes: The maximum-prize probability is an unusual requirement. It must be explicitly computed and traceable in the PAR sheet.

crossOperatorDepositLimit.value: Monthly deposit limit shared across all operators via the central Limitdatei
crossOperatorDepositLimit.notes: Cannot be implemented by a single operator; requires central system integration.

mandatoryBreak.value: Elapsed-time display plus mandatory notice and explicit acknowledgement every 60 minutes; for virtual slots, further play is permitted only 5 MINUTES AFTER that acknowledgement
mandatoryBreak.notes: This is a FORCED BREAK, not a reminder. Requires a session state machine, not just a timer.

parallelPlayControl.value: No cross-operator parallel play; central activation file; 5-minute waiting period before switching operators; auto-deactivation after 30 minutes inactivity

selfExclusion.notes: Statutory basis HIGH; portal URL MEDIUM.

centralSystemIntegrations.name: LUGAS
centralSystemIntegrations.purpose: Cross-operator parallel play control and activation file

mandatoryDeletion.value: Parallel-play data MUST be deleted after the waiting period, and other uses are banned
mandatoryDeletion.notes: This is a data-minimisation duty that CONFLICTS with a blanket long-retention audit design. Audit data must be classified so that this category can be deleted on schedule.

certification.labModel: Does not follow the usual ITL model
certification.notes: EACH INDIVIDUAL SLOT GAME requires prior GGL permission on application. A playable version must be supplied to the authority. Material changes require fresh permission. Permission is revocable at any time. Unpermitted slots constitute illegal gambling. This is a scheduling constraint on the product roadmap, not just a testing step.

recentChanges.change: Stake cap tiering to EUR 1 / EUR 3 / EUR 5
LUGAS expanded with Dataport; GGL 2025 activity report; section 32 interim Laender evaluation in progress

verificationRequired: GGL publication for the EUR 1 to EUR 3 / EUR 5 tiered stake cap, including the exact definition of the 90-day no-problem-gambling-indicator test
Accepted test laboratories, if any, alongside the per-game GGL permission
consultantNotes: Germany should be treated as a SEPARATE PRODUCT LINE, not a config variant of a UK build. Three factors cannot be expressed as flags: the jackpot ban (changes the maths model), per-game GGL permission (changes the release process), and LUGAS integration (changes the system boundary).
Germany is the only market verified here that tiers stake limits on BEHAVIOURAL RISK MARKERS, which pushes real-time risk scoring into the game session layer.
